name: Meagan Good
bio: Meagan Good (born August 8, 1981) is an American actress and model. She first gained critical attention for her role in the film Eve's Bayou (1997) prior to landing the role of Nina in the Nickelodeon sitcom Cousin Skeeter (1998–2001). In recent years, she is known for her role as Darla Dudley in the DCEU films Shazam! (2019) and Shazam! Fury of the Gods (2023). In March 2025, she married actor Jonathan Majors.
